verdict.rationale: incident.io documents a first-party Workflows feature that fires on incident events, such as automatically publishing to the status page when an incident is updated. This confirms an event-triggered automation engine exists, but the evidence shows only one action type and does not cover the condition logic or the broader toil-automation scope. missing for 10: evidence of condition/filter-based triggering, automated reminders/nudges, automated field changes, a broader catalog of workflow actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
